title: MBTA Transit Equity & Civic Improvement Dashboard
description: A multilingual, AI-powered civic tool that exposes transit inequity in Boston using live MBTA data. Features ghost bus detection, wait time Pain Index, RAG-based policy fact-checking, Ask the T chat, equity scorecards with neighborhood demographics, and an auto-generated open letter to the MBTA Board. Supports 7 languages including Haitian Creole and Arabic. Built with Google Gemini, TF-IDF RAG, optional LangGraph/MCP hooks, plotly, folium, and marimo.
